args.stdin:
.param set :basket_id '$params.basket_id'
WITH basket AS (
  SELECT * FROM shopping_baskets WHERE basket_id = :basket_id
),
items AS (
  SELECT sbi.product_sku, sbi.requested_quantity, pv.price_cents
  FROM shopping_basket_items sbi
  JOIN product_variants pv ON sbi.product_sku = pv.product_sku
  WHERE sbi.basket_id = :basket_id
),
inventory AS (
  SELECT product_sku, available_today_quantity
  FROM store_inventory
  WHERE store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM basket)
)
SELECT
  b.basket_id,
  b.customer_id,
  b.store_id,
  b.basket_status,
  b.record_path AS basket_record_path,
  (SELECT SUM(price_cents * requested_quantity) FROM items) AS total_amount_cents,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE requested_quantity > (SELECT available_today_quantity FROM inventory WHERE product_sku = items.product_sku)) AS insufficient_stock_count
FROM basket b;
WITH gen AS (SELECT hex(randomblob(16)) AS payment_id) SELECT payment_id, '/payments/' || payment_id || '.json' AS record_path FROM gen;

ok.message: Checkout completed for basket {params.basket_id}. Payment ID: {payment_id}.
